abstract: PURPOSE: To elucidate whether apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) values calculated from echo-planar diffusion-weighted MR imaging (EPDWI) are useful in the differential diagnosis of ovarian cystic masses. MATERIALS AND METHODS: EPDWI was performed in 131 patients with ovarian cystic masses (54 mature cystic teratomas, 35 endometrial cysts, four other benign cysts, 14 benign neoplasms, and 24 malignant neoplasms). The areas of the highest signal intensity on EPDWI (b = 1000 seconds/mm(2)) and the lowest ADC values within the cystic component were evaluated. RESULTS: On qualitative and quantitative analyses, mature cystic teratomas tended to show higher signal intensity and had areas of lower ADC values than endometrial cysts and other benign and malignant neoplasms (P < .005). In vitro scanning of the cystic contents of mature cystic teratomas confirmed that high signal on DWI or low ADC value was attributable to the keratinoid substance within the tumors. The difference in ADC between malignant and benign lesions were significant when mature cystic teratomas and endometrial cysts were included, but was not significant when they were excluded. CONCLUSION: The ADC value may add useful information to the differential diagnosis of ovarian cystic masses in limited populations, such as those with mature cystic teratomas with a small amount of fat.
abstract_ja:
目的：エコープラナー拡散強調MR画像（EPDWI）から算出した見かけの拡散係数（ADC）値が、卵巣嚢胞性腫瘤の鑑別診断に有用かどうかを明らかにすること。
材料と方法：卵巣嚢胞性腫瘤の患者131例に対しEPDWIを施行した（成熟嚢胞性奇形腫54例、子宮内膜嚢胞35例、その他の良性嚢胞4例、良性腫瘍14例、悪性腫瘍24例）。EPDWI（b = 1000 s/mm²）で最も高信号を示す部位と、嚢胞成分内の最も低いADC値を評価した。
結果：定性的・定量的解析において、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は子宮内膜嚢胞やその他の良性・悪性腫瘍と比べ、高信号を示す傾向があり、低ADC値の領域を有することが多かった（P < .005）。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の嚢胞内容物をin vitroで走査したところ、DWIでの高信号または低ADC値は腫瘍内のケラチン様物質に起因することが確認された。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と子宮内膜嚢胞を含めた場合には悪性と良性病変の間のADCの差が有意であったが、これらを除外すると有意ではなかった。
結論：ADC値は、少量の脂肪を含む成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例など限られた集団において、卵巣嚢胞性腫瘤の鑑別診断に有用な情報を追加しうる。
